title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and improve hygiene
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Context: Our repo accumulated many duplicated GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing, and release automation which increases maintenance cost and causes inconsistent checks across services. This PR consolidates common CI logic into a smaller set of reusable workflows, upgrades key actions and Node versions, improves cache keys and restore logic, and tidies CI documentation. Motivation: reduce duplicated YAML, speed up authoring of new checks, make CI behavior consistent across packages, and reduce flakes/cost by improving cache hit rates. Changes include: consolidated workflows into .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml; introduced reusable jobs for node-matrix, sdk-build, and lint; bumped actions/setup-node to v4 and standardized on Node 20 for JS pipelines; improved actions/cache restore keys and added explicit cache scopes for yarn/pnpm/node_modules; removed several deprecated per-repo workflow files and migrated required checks to branch protection; added a lightweight local CI doc docs/ci.md and updated CONTRIBUTING.md to document the new pipeline; added small helper scripts scripts/ci/run-tests.sh to unify test invocations. Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor CI for 48h, revert individual workflow changes quickly if failures appear. Checklist: [x] Consolidate workflows and add reusable templates; [x] Bump actions versions and node runtime; [x] Add cache improvements and matrix for SDKs; [x] Update docs and branch protection; [x] Smoke test via CI and confirm green checks across core repos. Impact: no runtime/customer-facing changes. Some CI job names changed which may affect monitoring dashboards and alerts; owners notified. Follow-ups: split long-running integration jobs into dedicated runners (ENG-3498), add GitHub Actions self-hosted runner pool for heavy GPU tests (ENG-3529).

release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into fewer reusable workflows. Standardized on Node 20 for JS/TS pipelines. Bumped core GitHub Actions to recommended majors. Improved cache hit rates and added per-package cache keys. Removed legacy per-repo workflow files. Updated CI docs and CONTRIBUTING guidance. No runtime changes. Owners: infra-team.
